card.category: software (Telegram bot for an AllDebrid account, self-hosted)
card.summary: No fee for the software; it has no allowance of its own. It needs an AllDebrid premium account's API key and a Telegram bot token.

record.category: software (Telegram bot for an AllDebrid account, self-hosted)

free_tier.stated: No fee for the software; it has no allowance of its own. It needs an AllDebrid premium account's API key and a Telegram bot token.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published by the software; the cap is the underlying account's and Telegram's.

retention.stated: Not stated by the software; the debrid service keeps or drops the item.

egress.terms: The bot hands back the debrid service's links or uploads through the Telegram bot token's route; the underlying account carries the traffic.

record.interface_detail: A private Telegram chat in front of a debrid account's API.
record.tooling: The user installs and runs the Python 3.6+ bot on a rented or free machine with a Telegram bot token, a Telegram App ID and Hash, and an AllDebrid API key.
record.chaining: A user-run front end for an AllDebrid premium account; it adds a Telegram control surface and no capacity. Hosted bots such as debrid/telegram-torbox-bot and debrid/telegram-deepbrid-bot come first.
record.limits_note: The software publishes no limit of its own.
record.binding_note: Nothing in the software binds; the account behind the key sets every wall.

identity_cost.detail: 'An AllDebrid premium account (For the API Key, you can get it from AllDebrid Options)', a Telegram bot token and a Telegram App ID and Hash are required.

record.reliability_note: Software that the user runs; it needs its own host. Every wall belongs to the AllDebrid account behind the key.
record.confidence_note: Only the README was read. Nothing was built or run.

evidence.quote: This is a Telegram bot that allows you to download files from AllDebrid.
evidence.proved: the software is a Telegram front end for AllDebrid

evidence.quote: * An AllDebrid premium account (For the API Key, you can get it from AllDebrid Options)
evidence.proved: a premium AllDebrid account is required
the awesome-debrid list names it under Telegram bots

record.notes: Last-resort option: a hosted debrid or a hosted bot comes first. The verdict is paid-only because the README requires an AllDebrid premium account.
